body_html:
“With a beautiful Aspen Backdrop and the reception at the Historic Hotel Jerome, this couldn’t be a more perfect night for our couple Gayleen & Michael Rothrock! This couple had a fun and amazing personalities! JAMMIN’ DJs provided our award winning DJ service and kept the dance floor packed all night long! Thank you to the Hotel Jerome and the Rothrocks for including JAMMIN’ DJs on your special day!”

~John Murray~
